title: Khronos open standards SDK materialization and fabric integration
accepted: Vulkan Profiles are used as a capability-description input while HRB retains resource authority
glslang SPIRV-Tools and SPIRV-Cross form the Shader Fabric standards toolchain
glTF Validator and KTX Software form Asset Graph interchange validation/transcoding providers
ANARI is a replaceable Render Fabric provider abstraction
OpenXR is the vendor-neutral XR runtime boundary
OpenCL is an optional heterogeneous compute backend and never a resource authority
OpenVX sample implementation semantics may inform Vision Fabric graph/operator design but the sample implementation is not a production/reference provider
NNEF Tools is an optional Model Artifact interchange adapter
all source materialization is immutable-pinned and namespaced under FA3 user data
All build-only transitive sources required for deterministic offline builds are immutable-pinned and remain non-authoritative
rejected: vendor or GPU SKU as global requirement
system Vulkan loader driver or ICD replacement
static or source materialization as current-host runtime PASS
